issues.description: Method parameter mismatch for Lecture.addGuestStudents: the problem statement (problem_statement.md) and the provided solution (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) define a public method addGuestStudents(int) with a single int parameter, but the template (template_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) declares addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, boolean validateInput) with an extra boolean parameter. This mismatch means code written to the specification or tests that call addGuestStudents(int) will not match the template's method signature and will cause confusion or compilation/test failures for students.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template method signature to match the problem statement and solution: public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents) { ... }. If input validation is desired in the template, implement it inside this single-parameter method or provide a private helper/overload that does validation so the public API stays consistent with the exercise specification.
